_comment: Exhibit index. PROVENANCE ONLY: what the artifact is, which account published it, what it shows on its face. Deliberately carries no characterisation of any person; allegations belong in filed pleadings, not in site metadata. Every field here was verified by opening the artifact, not inferred from its filename. Where a fact is not visible in the artifact it is recorded as null with an explicit precision/source field rather than guessed.
_provenance_note: The superseded version of this file carried a single `captured` field populated from the filename. That value is the POST date, not a capture date: all 14 claimed dates precede the date the asset first appears in git by two to nine months, and a screenshot cannot be captured before it exists. posted_date and captured_date are now separate. captured_date is genuinely unknown for every exhibit and is bounded above by captured_upper_bound, which is the first commit containing the asset.
